plainEnglish.summary: An abbreviation is explained where it is first used - unless it has become a dictionary word in its own right (such as "scuba" or "HTML"), appears in a logo, or sits inside a longer phrase that the non-literal language requirement already covers.
plainEnglish.whyItMatters: Unexplained abbreviations stop readers who are new to a domain, reading in a second language, or have a language or learning disability - and screen readers often pronounce them as words.
